reuse.why: Folds all six providers' upgrade/create/sync/notify sequence into one linkBankSyncAccount and keeps using findOrCreateBank, but the takeover rewrites unlinkAccount's column reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The five copied link bodies are gone, but the unlink reset is copied from unlinkAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the two guard calls are repeated in every handler.

placement.why: Shared link logic and guards live in accounts/app.ts beside the handlers and run before the bank row is created; link.ts would also have been a natural home.

scope.why: Changes serve the refactor and the four follow-up requests; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source is a small, related typing fix.

maintainability.why: A single linking definition with explicit fileId and syncTables variation is easy to own; the mutating 'assert' helper and copied unlink reset are the weak spots.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked clears the holder's bank columns with its own db.updateAccount instead of a shared piece of unlinkAccount

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is a condensed copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (inlined objects, direct return, dropped 'error' branch)

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a branch that unlinks the holder instead of throwing; linkBankSyncAccount itself stays clean (fileId and syncTables carry pre-existing variation) and every handler, Fintegra included, calls it
